title: Company-wide policies and processes: access, change, data, procurement, vendor, travel, templates
author: Aisha Patel
body:
Overview

This consolidated policy document describes Redwood Inference's company-wide processes for: access & permissions, change management, data management, procurement & expenses, vendor management, travel, and canonical internal templates. It is intended for managers, people-ops, engineers, finance, security, and any employee or contractor who requests access or interacts with vendors and company data.

Scope

Applies to all Redwood employees, contractors, and approved third parties who access Redwood systems or handle Redwood data. Team-specific operational procedures (runbooks) remain the authoritative operational source for service-specific steps.

Primary contacts and owners

- People Ops (policy owner): people-ops@redwood.com
- Security & Compliance (controls and audits): security@redwood.com
- Finance (procurement and expense policy): finance@redwood.com
- Eng-Infra (access provisioning): eng-infra@redwood.com

1) Access & permissions

Principles

- Least privilege: grant the minimum permissions required.
- Time-bound: requests for elevated access must include expiry.
- Separation of duties: production admin and deployment responsibilities are separated.
- Auditability: approvals and privileged session records are retained per retention schedule.

Onboarding / offboarding (summary)

1. People Ops initiates onboarding in the HR system.
2. Team owner completes Access Request Template with justification and duration.
3. Eng-Infra provisions accounts and records permissions in the access register.
4. Offboarding triggers automated deprovisioning; team owner verifies access removal.

Access request and approvals

- Use the Access Request Template for all provisioning; include justification and expiry.
- Approvers: direct manager + resource/service owner; privileged access adds Security review.
- SLAs: standard requests 2 business days; privileged requests 4 business hours with business-impact justification.

Privileged controls

- MFA required for all interactive access.
- Production admin access via approved jump host with session recording.
- Quarterly attestation required for all permanent admin roles.

2) Change management

Purpose and scope

Provide a consistent, auditable process to plan, test, approve, and implement changes to production systems while minimizing disruption and enabling fast recovery.

Change categories and approvals

| Change type | Examples | Approval required | Lead time |
|-------------|----------|-------------------|-----------|
| Standard | Config tweaks, low-risk infra changes | Team owner | 24-48 hours |
| Normal | Deployments, schema changes, scaling | Change approver + SRE | 3-5 business days |
| Emergency | Production outage hotfix | On-call SRE + Eng manager | Immediate (post-review) |

Normal change workflow

1. Create change ticket with rollback plan, test plan, and impact analysis.
2. SRE / Eng-Platform risk classification.
3. Schedule in change window or request exception.
4. Execute with change owner and runbook; monitor health checks.
5. Close ticket after verification and document lessons learned.

Emergency changes

- Require on-call SRE and engineering manager approval.
- Formal change ticket and retrospective within 48 hours.

Rollback and validation

- All changes must include a tested rollback and success/failure criteria.
- Post-change checks include telemetry (error rate, latency), business KPIs, and smoke tests.

3) Data management

Classification and handling

- Classes: Public | Internal | Confidential | Restricted.
- Handling rules by class: encryption, access controls, and third-party requirements escalate with sensitivity.

Retention and deletion

- Default retention: project data 3 years; logs 1 year; analytics datasets 5 years unless regulatory needs differ.
- Use Data Deletion Template for deletion requests; Data Owner approval required.

Backups and DR

- Critical datasets: RTO <= 4 hours; RPO <= 1 hour.
- Backups encrypted at rest and stored in segregated accounts. Restore drills quarterly for core services.

Encryption & KMS

- Sensitive data encrypted at rest and in transit. Production/customer keys managed in corporate KMS; access strictly limited and audited.

Third-party processors

- Cross-border transfers require Legal & Security review.
- Vendors processing Confidential/Restricted data must sign DPAs and complete the Vendor Security Questionnaire.

4) Procurement & expenses

Procurement principles

- Competitive procurement for purchases > $25,000 unless sole-source approved.
- PO required for contracts > $5,000.
- Cardholders must provide receipts within 5 business days and follow card policy.

Procurement workflow

1. Initiator files Procurement Request Template with cost center and justification.
2. Manager approval.
3. Finance review for budget and compliance; Finance issues PO if approved.
4. Vendor onboarding (Legal + Security) for external vendors.

Expense reimbursement

- Submit Expense Reimbursement Template within 30 days.
- Finance audits random samples monthly.

Capital vs operating spend

- Finance classifies and advises on capital vs operating treatment; contact finance@redwood.com for clarifications.

5) Vendor management

Lifecycle and reviews

1. Needs assessment and selection.
2. Risk assessment (security, compliance, financial).
3. Contracting and SLA negotiation with Legal & Procurement.
4. Onboarding: integration, access, contacts.
5. Quarterly reviews for strategic/high-risk vendors; annual for low-risk.

Security requirements for vendors

- Vendors handling Confidential/Restricted data must complete: Vendor Security Questionnaire, SOC2 or equivalent evidence, and a DPA where required.

Termination checklist

- Revoke credentials, confirm data deletion/return, reconcile final invoices. Procurement owns the checklist; Security verifies access revocation.

6) Travel policy

Booking and approvals

- Domestic travel: manager approval for estimated cost > $500.
- International travel: pre-approval by manager and People Ops; Security review for travel to specified high-risk countries.
- Use company travel portal / preferred vendors when available.

Allowable expenses and caps

- Airfare: economy for < 6 hours; premium economy for 6-10 hours with manager approval.
- Lodging: standard up to $250/night; exceptions by manager.
- Meals: up to $75/day; per diem for multi-day travel.
- Ground transport: rideshare or standard rental; receipts required.

Expense submission and safety

- Submit expense report with receipts within 10 business days of return. Missing receipts require manager written approval.
- Employees must register travel for certain countries; Security provides travel advisories.

7) Internal templates and attachments

Canonical templates (use these):
- Access Request Template
- Procurement Request Template
- Expense Reimbursement Template
- Vendor Security Questionnaire
- Change Request Template
- Data Deletion Template

Usage guidelines

- Templates live in the templates repo. Do not modify templates without People Ops approval. Use the current version for requests and audits.

Appendices

A. Quick reference table: owners and SLAs

| Area | Owner | Typical SLA |
|------|-------|-------------|
| Access provisioning | Eng-Infra | 2 business days |
| Privileged approvals | Security + Manager | 4 business hours |
| Standard change review | Eng-Platform / SRE | 3 business days |
| Procurement review | Finance | 3-5 business days |

B. Escalation contacts

- Production incident on-call: see status page and runbooks.
- Policy exceptions: people-ops@redwood.com (submit Exception Request form).

C. Links

- Templates repo: /confluence/policies-and-process/templates
- IT runbooks: /confluence/eng-infra/runbooks
- Security policies: /confluence/security-and-compliance

Change log

- 2026-03-04: Initial consolidated policy published.
- 2026-12-01: Updated retention and backup SLAs; clarified procurement thresholds and travel caps.
- 2026-12-15: Minor clarifications to access SLA and vendor review cadence.
- 2027-01-20: Editorial updates and clarifications to change windows and approval matrix.

Questions and feedback

Send feedback or request policy exceptions to people-ops@redwood.com.
